title: Caliburn G3 Pro Kit
description:
The UWELL CALIBURN G3 PRO POD KIT is the latest pro version pod system of Caliburn G family. Integrated with a 1000mAh rechargeable battery for long-lasting vaping, the UWELL CALIBURN G3 PRO POD KIT features a draw or button activated firing system delivering up to 35W output. Equipped with a large LCD screen to dynamically display the vaping details, the UWELL CALIBURN G3 PRO POD KIT works with the new UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD to hold 2.0ml capacity, utilizing the integrated mesh coil to create clouds of delicious vapor.

Features:

- 2A Type-C Charging Port

- Clearview Juice Window

- Pro-FOCS Flavor Tech

- Zinc Alloy Refined Appearance

Specifications

- Dimensions: 123 x 27 x 17mm

- Wattage Output: Max 35W

- Battery Capacity: 1000mAh

- Firing System: Draw or Button Activated

- Charging Port: Type-C

- Pod Capacity: 2ml

Package List:

1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 PRO POD KIT device
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD – 0.4OHM
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD – 1.2OHM
1 x Type-C Cable
1 x Manual
